meta.name: hellenist_siege
meta.prompt: A modern Hellenist city being invaded by sea monsters.

programs.brief: A colossal sea monster rises from the coastal inlet beside the modern Hellenist city, low enough for its head and tentacles to loom over the civic square; its wet armored body breaks paving and seawall into a grounded trace and publishes a pad contact anchor.

Distinct sea monsters surge inland from the inlet in an advancing attack, with varied serpentine bodies, fins, tentacles, wet scales, brine trails and impact craters; each instance should face the city rather than read as uniform decoration.

tokens.invasion: sea monsters are invading the city

root.label: the modern Hellenist city under a sea-monster siege
